name: evac_countdown
description: Display a live countdown timer on screen with remaining time
code:
local remaining = tonumber(${seconds}) or 90
while remaining > 0 do
  term.clear() term.setCursorPos(1,1)
  local m = math.floor(remaining / 60)
  local s = remaining % 60
  print("EVACUATION COUNTDOWN")
  print(string.format("%02d:%02d REMAINING", m, s))
  for i = 1, remaining do io.write("#") end
  print()
  sleep(1)
  remaining = remaining - 1
end
term.clear() term.setCursorPos(1,1)
print("COUNTDOWN COMPLETE")
return { done = true, elapsed = 90 }

name: evac_redstone_pulse
description: Emit a redstone pulse on a given side for a duration
code:
local side = "${side}" or "left"
local dur = tonumber(${duration}) or 1000
redstone.setOutput(side, true)
sleep(dur / 1000)
redstone.setOutput(side, false)
return { ok = true, side = side }
